info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Streaming Subscriptions Plans-v3-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscription Plans API provides businesses with the ability to access and list all available subscription plans for streaming services. This endpoint allows developers to retrieve detailed information about various plans, including pricing, features, and terms. Typical consumers of this API are developers integrating subscription functionalities into their applications, enabling users to choose the best fit for their needs. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance user engagement through tailored streaming offerings.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a list of available subscription plans. You can use this to inform users about the different options they have for subscribing.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving subscription plans. This request is used to access the available subscription plan options, including details such as pricing, duration, and features associated with each plan.
